verdict.rationale: Ollama's core interaction is natural-language chat with models (`ollama run`/chat, the desktop app, VS Code Chat). `ollama launch` also sets up coding agents that take natural-language instructions. However, nothing shows Ollama itself (pulling, removing or switching models, configuring the server) can be controlled through natural-language commands. Those operations are documented only as CLI commands, REST/SDK calls or GUI clicks. Missing for 10: natural-language control of Ollama's own management and configuration, documentation of an NL operating mode, and hands-on corroboration of NL-driven operation.
